report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned HTTP 200 with 63-94ms durations; traces show successful downstream calls (inventory, payment, order, redis, postgres) with no errors, and metrics show zero 502s and p95 checkout latency ~98ms. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause (http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency, memory-leak, bad-configuration). The alert appears to reflect healthy telemetry; no bounded fault can be established, so hand off for operator review.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency distribution for /v1/checkout to determine whether 63-94ms is anomalous
Error or timeout evidence in downstream services (order, inventory, payment, redis, postgres)
Resource saturation metrics (CPU, memory, connection pools) for gateway and downstream services
